environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on a bare EC2 instance behind an ALB with no additional request filtering. The ALB performs TLS termination and forwards all traffic directly to the application on port 8080. No WAF, no rate limiting, no additional proxy layers. DNS is configured with a wildcard CNAME for *.myapp.com pointing to the ALB.

config.network: public-facing ALB, security group allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
